intro: Kerlonian Evershade is a night elf Druid of the Claw resting at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. Having recently awakened from the long slumber within the Emerald Dream, he requires aid navigating the corrupted wilds to reach the safety of Maestra's Post.

p: Kerlonian Evershade belongs to the Druids of the Claw, followers of the bear totem who spent centuries sleeping in barrows and communion with the Emerald Dream. The Druids of the Claw were called from their slumber during the Third War. Found resting beneath the ancient trees of the Grove of the Ancients, Kerlonian is still shaking off the supernatural grogginess of his prolonged rest. His immediate concern is traveling safely through the troubled forests of Darkshore toward Maestra's Post on the border of Ashenvale.

The road out of the Grove of the Ancients is far from secure. The spreading blight in Darkshore has riled the local wildlife and brought hostile prowlers and grell close to the sacred clearings. Weakened from sleep and struggling with sudden bouts of exhaustion, Kerlonian relies on sympathetic travelers of the Alliance to protect him as he makes his way south to rejoin his fellow night elves.
